title: The glowing trough

aliases.name: Negative spike and its glowing trough
Fill below zero at a negative spike

members.role: on the word only the dip bleeds full of neg ink, from the line to its rule (zero, or a prior peak with `peak`) - the stretch over the rule stays unfilled - glowing round its edge
the dip's own edge lights as the fill lands, from where the line left the rule to where it returns (D40's gold segment, BOOM's lit price edge)
a dashed ring lands on the trough datum as the light arrives and holds (E56: a ring on a chart circles a datum)

does: A line dips under its rule and on the word only the dip bleeds full of ink to the line's true low, its edge lights and a dashed ring lands on the trough: the low reads as a place.

use_when.act: TURNS - a series read down to one number under a level (BRAVOS-USE-WHEN A46, R29)
use_when.shape: one signed series and its zero (A46), or a series and a prior level it fell under (R29's soft month: the prior print is the level)
use_when.use: a record low below zero, or a single weak print the sentence names ('one soft month in June'): fill the dip to its level, light its edge, ring the trough
use_when.dont: a positive series against zero (the sign colour carries it, E28); a low that is not a record where a ring alone says it; a dip under a hundredth of the plot's height - rescale to it first, the fill will not read (H row 22's June on the log monitor)

source: P71 T21 (harvest v2 A46 / R29; D40 12:46-13:08 read 2026-09-26: the flow line filled to zero, the last negative spike filled BELOW zero only in bright gold, its segment lit, a dashed ring on the trough); proved as private test-bed beats by projects/_proofs/p71-recipes/proof_t21.py (the fed reserves' spring 2025 dip below zero; H row 22's soft June under May's print; H row 5's railway under water) - golden fill-below-zero; no approved cut carries it
